TAGLINE: A quiet place for your dreams.
CONFIRM_START_OVER: This will erase your world. Are you sure?
WORKPLACE_PROMPT: What will you build here? This is the place where your future work lives.
HINT_MOVE: Tap the ground, or use the arrow keys, to walk
PIN_MISMATCH: The PINs did not match. Try again.
PIN_INFO: With a PIN, the garden locks itself whenever you leave the app.
FORGOT_PIN_INFO: Without the PIN, the only way in is to start over. This erases your world.
TIP_1: Water seedlings early in the morning.
TIP_2: Tomatoes need at least six hours of sun.
TIP_3: Mint grows fast, so keep it in a pot.
TIP_4: Add old leaves to the soil as compost.
TIP_5: Plant onions and garlic in autumn.
DECOR_HINT: Choose something, then tap where it should go. Drag to look around.
DECOR_SELECTED: Move it, change its colour, or take it away.
TOO_MANY: There is no more room here.
